# Good Air Language

> > Good Air Language is a comprehensive resource for online English teachers, providing reviews and information about ESL teaching platforms worldwide.

The site focuses on remote teaching opportunities with Chinese students, European platforms, and app-based ESL companies. It covers teaching requirements, pay structures, and platform comparisons to help teachers find legitimate online teaching jobs across countries including China, USA, Canada, and Europe.

## Key Topics

- Online ESL Teaching
- Chinese Students
- Teaching Platform Reviews
- TEFL/TESOL Certification
- Remote Teaching Jobs
- Non-Native Teachers
- Teacher Pay Rates
- USA/Canada Teacher Requirements
- App-Based Teaching Platforms
- Business English
- Work-From-Home Teaching
- PayPal Payment Methods
- Teaching Requirements
- European ESL Platforms
- Chinese Teaching Companies

## Getting Started & Essential Resources

- [Online English Teaching App List](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/online-english-teaching-app-list): Comprehensive list of app-based ESL teaching platforms (2023)
- [The Benefits of Teaching English Online](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/benefits-of-teaching-online): Benefits of online ESL teaching: flexibility, work-and-travel lifestyle

## Top Platform Reviews

- [Preply](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/preply): Preply review: USA-based, set-your-rate platform, Russia/Ukraine students
- [HelloKid Review For Teachers](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/hellokid): HelloKid review: Beijing-based, hiring post-2021 Chinese company shutdown
- [Learnlight Review for Online English Teachers](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/learnlight): Learnlight (ex-ISUS): Barcelona-based, 15 languages, business English focus
- [iTutor](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/itutor): iTutor review: USA school districts platform, US-based teachers only

## Chinese Student Platforms

- [BiteABC](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/biteabc): BiteABC review: Teach Chinese kids 5-16, TEFL/TESL required, PayPal payment
- [Whales English](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/sprout4future): Whales English (formerly Sprout 4 Future): China-based, National Geographic
- [Kaifu](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/kaifu): Kaifu English: Native speakers teach Chinese kids 3-15, one-to-one classes
- [ABC International Group](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/abc-international-group): ABC International Group: US/Canada natives, bachelor's degree required
- [UASK Education](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/uask-education): UASK Education: Ottawa-based, English/French for Chinese students

## International & Multi-Language Platforms

- [Tutlo](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/tutlo): Tutlo review: Poland-based ESL platform for adults and teens
- [Antoree](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/antoree): Antoree review: Vietnam-based 1-to-1 classes, hires non-native teachers
- [Bansho](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/bansho): Bansho review: NYC app for literacy/math tutoring with flexible teaching
- [Air Reading](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/air-reading): Air Reading: USA/Canada teachers for K-3 reading instruction, TESOL preferred

## Optional & Archived Platforms

- [Profy](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/profy): Colombia-based Profy review: $10/hr fixed pay, now out of business
- [UTalkABC](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/utalkabc): UTalkABC review: Chinese students, South African teachers accepted (closed)
- [Tutoring 360](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/tutoring-360): Tutoring 360 review: Korean students, native/non-native pay varies (offline)
- [Blazaar](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/blazaar): Blazaar review: Barcelona multi-language platform, closed July 2018
- [Hiring the Week of July 15th, 2019](https://www.goodairlanguage.com/hiring-july-15): Weekly hiring update: VIPKID, iTutorGroup, GoGoKid openings July 2019
